text:
maria: Hey infra team — onboarding Satellite (acct: 901234567890) for eu-west-12 pilot. Need p5/p4d/g5 quota increases across 3 AZs (eu-west-12a/b/c), plus ENI and EIP allowances. Planning to warm-pool 4x p5s overnight for canary traffic. Can infra raise quotas or advise next steps? cc @jon @lina

infra-bot: Created support ticket #INC-2026-5467 with AWS. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/INC-2026-5467 — AWS asked for exact SKUs and AZ distribution.

jon: Thanks. Maria — confirm account alias and exact SKUs. I need: p5.48xlarge (p5), p4d.24xlarge (p4d), g5.48xlarge (g5). Also ENIs per AZ and elastic IPs needed. I'll run the quota audit script and paste results.

maria: Account alias: satellite-prod. SKUs as above. Target quota: p5=8, p4d=4, g5=6 across the region (split 4/2/0 across AZs). ENIs: +200, EIPs: +50. Warm-pool: 4x p5 on-demand reserved as warmpool for 12 hours on rollout night.

jon: Running quota-audit...
jon: ```bash
./tools/quota-audit.sh --account 901234567890 --region eu-west-12
# returns current limits: p5:0, p4d:0, g5:0, ENI:60, EIP:5
```

lina: Subnet note — the target VPC has /20 per AZ, but we currently only have two subnets in eu-west-12b/c. We'll need a third subnet in 12a and bump route table NAT throughput. Also check NAT gateway IP limit for burst.

infra-bot: AWS support replied: please provide AMI family and expected launch patterns (steady vs burst). Also asked to attach an architecture diagram.

maria: Attached simple diagram in thread (link: https://drive.reddoc/internal/satellite-onboard/diagram.png) — steady traffic with short ramp to 4 instances for warmpool, then scale to 16 p5s for peak. Also, budget OK for first 30 days for on-demand warmpool.

aws-accounts-bot: Update: limit increase submitted — Service Quotas case SQ-987654. Requested increases: p5->8, p4d->4, g5->6, ENI->260, EIP->55. Estimated ETA 72-120 hours. Will post updates here.

jon: I'll also submit internal uplift for subnet expansion and ask networking to pre-allocate NATs. @lina can you own NAT/EIP follow-up?

lina: On it. I'll open a networking ticket and schedule a quick runbook for warmpool teardown to control cost. ETA: 24h for ticket + 48h for subnet creation.

maria: Thanks team. Please ping me when any block persists beyond 5 days — we need to freeze rollout if quota not granted.

jon: noted. I'll attach the CSV of SKUs and region mappings to the AWS case.

infra-bot: Case SQ-987654 updated: "Requested limits are in progress." :thumbsup:
